name: Brightwater Plumbing & Heating
headline: Your local plumber in Lancaster
tagline: Leaks, boilers, bathrooms and repairs. Fixed quotes before we start, tidy work, and we turn up when we say we will.
emergencyText: Burst pipe or no heating? Same-day emergency call-outs

services.title: Boiler installation
services.text: New combi and system boilers fitted, old boiler removed, controls set up. Manufacturer warranty registered for you.

services.title: Boiler repair & servicing
services.text: Breakdowns diagnosed and fixed, annual services and landlord gas safety certificates.

services.title: Leaks & emergencies
services.text: Burst pipes, leaking radiators, overflowing cisterns. We isolate, fix and make good.

services.title: Bathrooms & showers
services.text: Full bathroom refits, electric and mixer showers, wet rooms and accessible bathrooms.

services.title: Radiators & heating
services.text: New radiators, power flushing, thermostatic valves and cold-spot fixes.

services.title: Taps, toilets & blockages
services.text: Dripping taps, running toilets, slow drains. Small jobs welcome.

reviews.text: Boiler died on a Friday night. They were round first thing Saturday and had the heating back on by lunch. Fair price, no fuss.
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.text: Fitted our new combi in a day and left the place spotless. Explained the controls properly too.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Used them for three rental properties now. Gas certificates always on time and they deal with tenants directly.
reviews.author: J. Patel
